probableCause: Notifier.subjectFor calls customer.language().toLowerCase() but legacy customers have a null language, so it throws a NullPointerException before choosing the English default.
evidence: NPE message: the return value of Customer.language() is null.
Notifier.java:8 dereferences language() without a null check.
The failing test creates the customer with a null language to model a legacy customer.

possibleSolutions.solution: Treat a null or blank language as the default (English) in Notifier.subjectFor.
tradeoffs: Hides missing data; a data migration that fills the language would fix the source.

confidenceReason: The exception message and the test agree on the null value.
limitations: No spec or ADR was provided for the notification package.
